question: What release cadence should this repository run on, and how should out-of-band (mid-week urgent) releases be authorized?
options: Weekly calendar: Mon-Fri merge window (closes Friday), Saturday release day, Sunday consumer-adoption day, timezone America/Los_Angeles (governance/release-calendar.json). Versioning stays plain semver. A weekend merge attempt is blocked unless it is the release PR itself or carries the owner-only release:out-of-band label. Out-of-band releases are allowed on any day, for any urgent update the owner approves (not only security fixes), release only release:out-of-band-flagged changesets, default to patch-only, and allow a minor bump only when the changeset also carries owner-approved: minor; major is never allowed out of band.
CalVer scheme YY.WW.N (ISO week-year/week plus a same-week counter).
No fixed cadence; release whenever a change lands.
recommendation: Option 1 (weekly calendar, plain semver, owner-only out-of-band label).
decision: Adopted: weekly release calendar (Mon-Fri merge window, Saturday release, Sunday consumer adoption, America/Los_Angeles), plain semver (both proposed CalVer options rejected -- a version that moves on a clock rather than on a real content change is not a useful signal), and an owner-only release:out-of-band label permitting an urgent release on any day (widened from 'security fixes and broken releases only' to any urgent update the owner approves, per the follow-up owner decision at #1187 comment 5800369031 item 2). Standing cadence rule stated by the owner at #1187 comment 5799002037. Implementation (governance/release-calendar.json, scripts/lib/release-calendar.mjs, .github/workflows/release-calendar.yml) is tracked on PR #1316, stacked on #1265/#1266; the check is not yet a required status context -- PR #1316's own 'Rollout' section runs it report-only for one week first, and the owner makes it required as the final rollout step.
notes: Backfilled from the owner's standing cadence rule (#1187 comment 5799002037), the owner's follow-up widening of out-of-band scope (#1187 comment 5800369031, item 2), and PR #1316's own body, which the owner has revised twice by direct decision (moving versioning from a proposed CalVer scheme to plain semver, and applying a second-opinion review's findings in full). PR #1316 was still open, not yet merged, at the time this record was written (2026-09-23) -- the cadence POLICY itself is decided; its code implementation and required-check rollout are in progress per the PR's own 'Rollout' section. Classified tier-2 (business/priority trade-off and release-calendar enforcement the owner ultimately makes required), decidedBy owner. The reviewing session's exact instance/provider/model identity for the PR's own second-opinion review was not captured at the time; see docs/contracts/decision-record.json's note on backfilled reviews[] entries.
